questions.question: Examples of non-vascular plants are labelled
questions.explanation: Marchantia (I) is a liverwort and Spirogyra (II) is an alga. Both lack specialised vascular tissues such as xylem and phloem, so they are non-vascular plants.

questions.subject: Biology
questions.question: The part labelled I in the pregnancy diagram is the
questions.explanation: Label I points to the tube extending from the uterus towards the ovary. This tube is the oviduct, also called the Fallopian tube.

questions.subject: Biology
questions.question: The part labelled III in the insect diagram is the
questions.explanation: The insect body is divided into head, thorax and abdomen. Label III indicates the central region, the thorax, where the legs are attached.

questions.subject: Biology
questions.question: The kidney shown in the diagram is responsible for
questions.explanation: The kidney filters the blood and regulates water and salt concentrations in body fluids. This homeostatic function is called osmoregulation.

questions.subject: Biology
questions.question: The organelle that shows the organism has plant characteristics is labelled
questions.explanation: Label II identifies the chloroplast. Chloroplasts contain chlorophyll and carry out photosynthesis, which is a defining plant characteristic.
